name: Neurotoxins (Botox, Dysport, Xeomin, Daxxify)
what: Blocks the nerve signal (acetylcholine release) to a muscle so it relaxes and the line it creases softens.

name: Jeuveau
what: A botulinum toxin type A made with Hi-Pure purification, used for frown lines between the brows.

name: Frown lines (glabella) toxin
what: Toxin in the corrugator and procerus muscles stops the frown that carves the vertical 11 lines.

name: Forehead lines toxin
what: Small doses in the frontalis soften horizontal lines; too much or too low drops the brow.

name: Crow's feet toxin
what: Toxin in the outer orbicularis oculi relaxes the squint lines at the corners of the eyes.

name: Masseter toxin (jaw slimming, clenching)
what: Toxin in the masseter weakens the chewing muscle to slim the lower face and ease clenching.

name: Lower face toxin: mouth corners and chin (DAO, mentalis)
what: Toxin in the depressor anguli oris lets the corners of the mouth lift instead of pulling down.

name: Neck bands (platysma) toxin
what: Toxin along the platysmal bands relaxes the cords that run from jaw to collarbone and sharpens the jawline.

name: Hyaluronic acid fillers
what: A cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel that binds water and restores volume or support where it is placed.

name: Juvéderm (Voluma, Volbella, Vollure, Volux)
what: A family of HA fillers of different firmness, each made for a different depth and area of the face.

name: Restylane
what: HA fillers built on NASHA and OBT gel technology for lips, cheeks and lines.

name: Evolysse (Form and Smooth)
what: HA fillers cross-linked at near-freezing temperature to keep the HA chains longer.

name: Belotero
what: A soft HA filler that spreads evenly into the dermis for fine lines.

name: SkinVive
what: Tiny droplets of thin HA placed in the skin to improve hydration and smoothness, not volume.

name: Lip filler
what: HA placed in the lip body and border for shape, volume and hydration.

name: Cheek filler
what: HA on the cheekbone or in the deep fat pads lifts and restores the midface.

name: Jawline filler
what: HA along the mandible and angle sharpens and lifts the jawline.

name: Chin filler
what: HA on the chin bone projects and lengthens a weak chin.

name: Non-surgical nose job
what: Small amounts of HA reshape the nasal bridge and tip without surgery.

name: Under-eye (tear trough) filler
what: A little HA in the tear trough supports the lower lid and hides the fat-pad bulge.

name: Temple filler
what: Filler in the temple restores hollowing that ages the upper face.

name: Smile lines (nasolabial) filler
what: HA under the fold from nose to mouth softens laugh lines.

name: Hand rejuvenation
what: Filler or fat on the back of the hand hides veins and tendons lost to volume loss.

name: Filler safety: vascular occlusion and hyaluronidase
what: Knowing the arteries and planes keeps filler out of vessels; hyaluronidase dissolves HA if it goes wrong.

name: Sculptra
what: Poly-L-lactic acid particles that trigger the body to make its own collagen over months.

name: Radiesse
what: Calcium hydroxylapatite microspheres that add volume now and stimulate collagen later.

name: AlloClae (donor fat)
what: Processed donor fat used as filler for body contouring; he argues against it.

name: PRFM (platelet-rich fibrin matrix)
what: Your own blood spun to concentrate platelets, then gelled with calcium/thrombin to act as a slow collagen-building filler.

name: PRP for hair loss
what: Platelet-rich plasma injected in the scalp releases growth factors that wake up thinning follicles.

name: Exosomes
what: Tiny cell-derived vesicles carrying growth factors, applied after microneedling or injected for skin and hair.

name: Salmon DNA / polynucleotides
what: Purified DNA fragments from salmon injected to support skin repair; the trend he was quoted on.

name: AquaGold microinfusion
what: A vial-stamp of 24K gold-plated microneedles that delivers a cocktail (HA, toxin, PRP) into the dermis.

name: Fraxel Dual and Restore
what: Fractional laser columns heat microscopic zones of skin to rebuild collagen and lift pigment, leaving skin in between intact.

name: Fraxel CO2 (ablative fractional)
what: An ablative laser that vaporises columns of skin for deep resurfacing of wrinkles and scars.

name: Clear + Brilliant
what: A low-energy fractional laser for tone, texture and pores with almost no downtime.

name: PicoWay
what: Picosecond pulses shatter pigment by pressure (photoacoustic) rather than heat.

name: Cutera excel V (vascular laser)
what: Green and Nd:YAG wavelengths heat haemoglobin to close visible vessels and redness.

name: Laser Genesis
what: Gentle 1064 nm pulses warm the dermis to calm redness and build collagen.

name: AviClear
what: A 1726 nm laser that selectively heats and shrinks sebaceous glands to treat acne.

name: Laser hair removal
what: Laser light absorbed by hair pigment heats and disables the follicle.

name: Laser tattoo removal
what: Ultra-short pulses break tattoo ink into particles the immune system clears.

name: Juliet vaginal laser
what: An erbium laser for vaginal laxity and dryness.

name: Morpheus8
what: Gold-coated microneedles deliver radiofrequency heat deep in the skin and fat to tighten and remodel.

name: Radiofrequency tightening (RF microneedling, EndyMed, PelleFirm)
what: Needles that heat at a set depth to stimulate collagen in skin and scars.

name: FaceTite, AccuTite and BodyTite
what: A cannula under the skin and an external electrode heat fat and tighten skin from inside.

name: Evoke (hands-free RF)
what: A hands-free radiofrequency mask that heats the lower face and neck to tighten.

name: EMFACE
what: Radiofrequency heats the skin while electrical stimulation contracts facial muscles to lift without needles.

name: EMSCULPT NEO
what: Radiofrequency heats fat while a magnetic field forces supramaximal muscle contractions, building muscle and reducing fat.

name: Ultherapy
what: Focused ultrasound heats points down to the SMAS layer to lift and tighten.

name: Underarm sweating: miraDry and toxin
what: Microwave energy destroys underarm sweat and odour glands permanently.

name: CoolSculpting
what: Controlled cooling kills fat cells, which the body clears over weeks.

name: Facelift
what: Lifts and repositions the SMAS and skin of the lower face and jowls.

name: Neck lift
what: Removes fat and loose skin and tightens the platysma under the jaw.

name: Eyelid surgery (blepharoplasty)
what: Removes or repositions eyelid skin and fat pads; lower lids can be done from inside the eye.

name: Brow lift
what: Raises a low or heavy brow by lifting the forehead tissues.

name: Fat transfer
what: Fat taken by liposuction is purified and re-injected to restore volume in the face or body.

name: Tumescent liposuction
what: Fat is suctioned through a cannula after the area is swollen with dilute local anaesthetic.

name: Male breast reduction
what: Removes excess glandular tissue and fat from the male chest.

name: Thread lift
what: Dissolvable barbed threads placed under the skin lift sagging tissue and stimulate collagen.

name: MyEllevate
what: A light-guided permanent suture slung under the jaw tightens the neck without open surgery.

name: Ellacor micro-coring
what: Hollow needles remove tiny cores of skin (up to 8%) so the skin heals tighter without scars.

name: Earlobe repair
what: A split or stretched earlobe is cut and sutured back together.

name: Scar revision
what: Surgical or laser techniques reshape a scar so it lies flatter and less visible.

name: Mole removal
what: A mole is shaved or cut out and sent to the lab.

name: Mohs micrographic surgery
what: Removes a skin cancer layer by layer, checking 100% of each margin under the microscope until it is clear.

name: Basal and squamous cell carcinoma
what: The most common skin cancer: slow-growing, it spreads locally if left alone.

name: Melanoma
what: Cancer of pigment cells; its depth decides the stage and the treatment.

name: Melanoma mRNA vaccine and immunotherapy
what: A personalised mRNA vaccine built from the tumour's own mutations, given with immunotherapy to cut recurrence.

name: Actinic keratosis and photodynamic therapy
what: A light-activated drug destroys precancerous sun-damaged cells.

name: Skin checks and dermoscopy
what: A yearly head-to-toe exam, with a dermatoscope for suspicious spots, catches cancers early.

name: Reconstruction after Mohs
what: Flaps and grafts close the wound left after removing a cancer, especially on the nose, lids and ears.

name: Acne
what: Blocked pores, oil, bacteria and inflammation in the pilosebaceous unit.

name: Acne scars: subcision and TCA CROSS
what: Rolling, boxcar and icepick scars each need a different fix: subcision, TCA CROSS, lasers or filler.

name: Rosacea
what: Chronic facial redness, flushing, visible vessels and breakouts on the cheeks and nose.

name: Melasma and hyperpigmentation
what: Excess melanin, driven by sun, hormones and heat, forms dark patches.

name: Milia
what: Tiny keratin cysts trapped under the skin, often from heavy products.

name: Hair loss (androgenetic alopecia)
what: Follicles shrink under hormone signals; PRP, exosomes and drugs try to reverse it.

name: Sclerotherapy (spider and varicose veins)
what: A solution injected into the vein irritates its lining so it collapses and is reabsorbed.

name: Festoons (malar mounds)
what: Swollen bags over the upper cheek below the lower lid, hard to treat.

name: Skin aging and collagen loss
what: With age the face loses collagen, fat and bone, so the skin deflates and sags.

name: Loose skin after weight loss (GLP-1)
what: Rapid weight loss on GLP-1 drugs empties fat compartments and leaves loose skin.

name: Cellulite
what: Fat pushing up between tight fibrous bands dimples the skin.

name: Lymphatic drainage
what: Light massage moves lymph fluid to reduce swelling after body procedures.

name: Retinoids: retinol and tretinoin
what: Vitamin A derivatives speed cell turnover and build collagen; they can purge first.

name: Niacinamide
what: Vitamin B3 strengthens the barrier, calms redness and blocks pigment transfer; oral nicotinamide lowers skin cancer risk.

name: Vitamin C + ferulic antioxidant
what: Antioxidants neutralise UV free radicals and support collagen.

name: Pigment inhibitors (arbutin, kojic, tranexamic)
what: Ingredients that block tyrosinase or other steps of melanin production.

name: AHA / BHA exfoliants
what: Acids loosen the bonds between dead cells to smooth texture and clear pores.

name: Moisturizers, hyaluronic acid and the skin barrier
what: The lipid barrier keeps water in and irritants out; the right moisturizer repairs it.

name: Sunscreen
what: Mineral filters reflect and absorb UVA and UVB before they damage DNA and collagen.

name: Chemical peels
what: An acid solution removes damaged layers so new skin replaces them; depth depends on the acid.

name: DiamondGlow
what: A diamond tip exfoliates and vacuums while serums are pushed into the skin.

name: HydraFacial
what: A vortex tip cleanses, extracts and hydrates in one pass.

name: Microneedling (SkinPen)
what: Fine needles make micro-injuries that trigger collagen repair.

name: LED and oxygen facials (OxyLight)
what: Red and blue light wavelengths calm inflammation, kill acne bacteria and support repair.

name: EXOMIND (TMS)
what: Magnetic pulses stimulate the prefrontal cortex to support mood, focus and sleep.

name: IV therapy
what: Fluids, vitamins and NAD+ given into a vein.
